---
title: "Database Downloads"
subtitle: Download link for the SQLite database file
---

```{css, echo=FALSE}
th {
  white-space: nowrap;
}
```

The pilot database is published as an asset on this repository's [latest GitHub release](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/vannmiljo-pilot/releases/latest). It is the only file this site depends on: every page queries it directly in the browser.

## Available Database

```{r}
library(tibble)

database_tbl <- tribble(
  ~File,                      ~Schema,                                 ~Download,
  "vannmiljo_pilot.sqlite",   "[DB Schema (Full)](./db-schema.qmd)",   "[Download](https://github.com/seafood-hazards/vannmiljo-pilot/releases/latest/download/vannmiljo_pilot.sqlite)"
)

knitr::kable(database_tbl)
```

The download link always resolves to the newest release, so it does not need updating when a new database version is published.
